{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reuse df_clean from previous step
# Perform stratified analysis: compare conversion rates within each customer segment

# Calculate conversion rate within each segment for each channel
df_stratified = df_clean.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().reset_index()
print('Stratified conversion rates by segment and channel:')
print(df_stratified)

# Compute difference in conversion rates within each segment
# Only include segments with both channels represented
differences = []
for seg in df_clean['customer_segment'].unique():
    seg_data = df_clean[df_clean['customer_segment'] == seg]
    if len(seg_data['channel'].unique()) < 2:
        continue  # Skip if not both channels present
    rate_email = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
    rate_paid = seg_data[seg_data['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
    diff = rate_email - rate_paid
    differences.append({
        'segment': seg,
        'email_rate': rate_email,
        'paid_search_rate': rate_paid,
        'difference': diff
    })

# Convert to DataFrame
diff_df = pd.DataFrame(differences)
print('\nDifference in conversion rates by segment:')
print(diff_df)

# Overall summary
overall_mean_email = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
overall_mean_paid = df_clean[df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()
overall_diff = overall_mean_email - overall_mean_paid

print(f'\nOverall conversion rate difference (email - paid_search): {overall_diff:.4f}')
print(f'Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in loyal: {diff_df[diff_df["segment"] == "loyal"]["difference"].iloc[0]:.4f}')
print(f'Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in returning: {diff_df[diff_df["segment"] == "returning"]["difference"].iloc[0]:.4f}')
print(f'Within-segment difference (email - paid_search) in new: {diff_df[diff_df["segment"] == "new"]["difference"].iloc[0]:.4f}')"}
